english.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for an overall effect or a vague belief or feeling about something.
Use 印象 when the glimpse means a faint or vague impression rather than a visual look.

examples.english: That film left quite an impression on me.
examples.traditional: 嗰套戲畀我嘅印象幾深。
examples.jyutping: go2 tou3 hei3 bei2 ngo5 ge3 jan3 zoeng6 gei2 sam1

examples.english: I only have a vague glimpse of what happened.
examples.traditional: 我對件事只有個模糊印象。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 gin6 si6 zi2 jau5 go3 mou4 wu4 jan3 zoeng6
